text:
samir: @channel seeing a surge of 503s from hosted inference since 08:42 UTC. Upstream inference workers in us-west-2 keep restarting with SIGSEGV right after we rolled the quantized variant. Customers hitting timeouts. logs below, need triage.

jordan_oncall: On it. Which model variant + pool? Any recent deploys?

samir: model=rwd-ggml-v1-q4f16, pool=hosted-usw2-a, deploy started ~08:40. qps spiked ~3x then segfaults began. sample runner log: 
```
2026-03-17T08:42:11.123Z runner[4217]: *** SIGSEGV (11) at 0x7f8a12b3
2026-03-17T08:42:11.124Z runner[4217]: backtrace: libattn.so+0x4f1a
2026-03-17T08:42:11.125Z runner[4217]:   at attn_kernel(const float*, kv_cache*, ...) (kernel.cu:176)
2026-03-17T08:42:11.126Z runner[4217]: gpu_mem: 98.6% used
```

maria_eng: this looks like a crash in the fused attention kernel in the quantized path. metrics show a sharp GPU memory spike (~98%) immediately before the segfault. Sequence lengths were high (~1600-2048) for a subset of requests.

liam_cs: Which customers were impacted? Any billing or SLA hits we should notify about?

samir: two mid-market customers hit elevated 503 rates and latencies spiked; CS already fielding tickets. No billing changes yet but SLA alerts fired.

maria_eng: quick repro steps I used locally (smallest repro):
```
# send a long-context request to the q4 variant repeatedly
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-ggml-v1-q4f16","input":"'"`python -c 'print("x"*5000)'`"'"}'
```
After ~10 concurrent long requests the runner reproducibly crashes with SIGSEGV.

jordan_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) rollback the quantized variant on hosted-usw2-a, 2) add routing fallback to rwd-ggml-v1-q8 for the pool, 3) scale pool +20% while investigating. Can someone perform rollback now?

maria_eng: rolling back now. Triggering deploy: `deploy rollback hosted-usw2-a rwd-ggml-v1-q4f16`

deploy-bot: started deploy rollback 3591112230 by maria_eng -> status: in_progress

deploy-bot: deploy rollback 3591112230 -> SUCCESS (08:43:02 UTC) :white_check_mark:

support-ops: routing fallback added to rwd-ggml-v1-q8 for hosted-usw2-a, and pool autoscale bumped +20%. Notified impacted customers with an ETA for a permanent fix.

sophia_research: likely cause: quantized attention kernel mis-handles certain buffer alignments at long seq_len after the swap. I'll try to minimize a repro to open with the kernel team / NV driver if needed.

maria_eng: gathering core dumps, nvcrash logs, and driver dmesg. PR for short-term hotfix (pin fallback kernel path): https://git.internal/redwood/infra/patches/1234 (mock).

jordan_oncall: thanks — next steps: eng-runtime and eng-ml to pair on reproducer + open upstream bug (include core, min repro, driver version). CS to keep customers updated. I'll create an incident ticket and assign follow-ups. @maria_eng @sophia_research please attach reproducer to the ticket. :thumbsup:

samir: thank you all. Main customer impact mitigated by rollback + fallback routing. Please post any new findings in this thread and any follow-up incident notes.
